rationale: The discourse has reached a stable impasse: investors/management now accept a no-closure route only if it is near-equivalent to closure-led savings, while IG Metall, the Works Council, and Lower Saxony continue to hold firm on no closures and no compulsory redundancies. The last two rounds mainly reassert positions and the expert merely narrowed the economic bounds; further rounds without a new bridging proposal are unlikely to resolve the core conflict.
